# Contributing to WinUtilX

Thank you for helping improve WinUtilX.

## Development

Clone the repository and compile the project:

~~~powershell
git clone https://github.com/MohamedBabaamer/WinUtilX.git
cd WinUtilX
.\Compile.ps1
~~~

To compile and launch the GUI:

~~~powershell
.\Compile.ps1 -Run
~~~

## Source of truth

Edit the source files under "config/", "functions/", "scripts/", "xaml/", and "tools/".

Do not edit or commit the generated "winutil.ps1".

## Pull requests

Keep pull requests focused and explain what changed and how it was tested.
